name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
tagline: The largest art museum in the Western Hemisphere. Plan a full day.
description: The Met spans 5,000 years of art across two million objects, from Egyptian tombs and Greek statuary to Vermeer, Van Gogh, and the American Wing. Pay-what-you-wish for NY/NJ/CT residents.
hours_summary: Sun–Tue, Thu 10 AM – 5 PM · Fri–Sat 10 AM – 9 PM · closed Wed
review_long:
Two million objects, 5,000 years of human creativity, all under one roof. The Met's collection is broader than any single museum visit can cover — Egyptian temples reassembled stone by stone, the only Vermeer paintings on permanent display in the Western Hemisphere, the entire American Wing — so most visitors do well to pick three departments and accept that they won't see the rest.

NY/NJ/CT residents pay what they wish; everyone else pays the full $30. The Met Cloisters in Fort Tryon Park is included on the same ticket if used within three days.

tips.text: Enter from the 81st St side to skip the Fifth Avenue queue.
The Roof Garden is open seasonally — check on the way in.
